india_trends.summary: The Centre has begun moving onion buffer stocks from Nashik to major consumption centres through dedicated railway rakes, or ‘Kanda Express’, to boost supplies and contain seasonal price increases.

The project, to be executed in 48 months, aims to enhance road connectivity in the region and expands Ceigall's infrastructure portfolio.
